Definition: to be (causatively, make) sharp or (figuratively) severe
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be sharp, be alert, be keen; 1a) (Qal) to be sharp, be keen; 1b) (Hiphil) to sharpen; 1c) (Hophal) to be sharpened
